newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Two Dutch tourists murdered in Brazil.
newsitem.headline: Two Dutch tourists murdered in Brazil.

text.p: Two Dutch tourists were murdered on Friday in the Brazilian city of Recife in what appeared to be a drug-related crime, police said.

Aloysius Theodorus Overtoon, 35, and Wilhelmus Adrianes Joannes Van Kampean, 28, were shot in a slum area of central Recife that is dominated by the drug trade, a police spokesman said. "It appears they were buying drugs," he said.
Van Kampean, who was shot four times, died immediately. Overtoon was taken to a hospital suffering from a bullet wound and died several hours later, the spokesman said.
The killers stole cash, a camera and sunglasses belonging to the two men, he said.
